messages:
Kevin L: Heads-up: nightly linkcheck failing on prod build for /guides/migrate-v2 — anchor 404 for 'runtime-params'. CI log: https://ci.redwood/integration/5421
Maria C: Repro'd locally with docusaurus@2.9.1. It looks like the h2 `Runtime params` was auto-slugged to something different (inline code + parentheses caused an extra suffix).
Todd P: Seen this before — mdx inline code in headings can produce encoded slugs (e.g. `runtime(params)` -> runtime-params-1). Suggest explicit HTML id: `## Runtime params {#runtime-params}` to stabilize.
Frances H: I'm on it — prepping a PR. Quick heads-up: the PR that fixed emoji anchors earlier regressed an image relpath in /examples; I'll add a regression test to catch that. @Kevin L do you want a canary rollout for the docs site?
docs-bot: Preview build ready: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/4218 :white_check_mark:
Maria C: Also, consider the docusaurus slug plugin option to preserve some punctuation (`removeMarkdown: false`) or normalize differently. Could avoid version-to-version slug diffs.
Kevin L: Good. Please include a small changelog note under docs/migration and add a linkcheck exception only if we confirm it's a false positive.
Todd P: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4218 — adds explicit header ids, tweaks mkdocs/docusaurus anchor config, and includes a tiny linkcheck unit test that validates generated slugs.
Frances H: Reviewed and left 2 nits. One issue: a code sample that previously used inline backticks in headings got trimmed in the mdx pipeline. Switched to a fenced code block to be safe:
```
## Runtime params {#runtime-params}

Use this to set cache and batch sizes.
```
Kevin L: Looks good. Merge after CI green. I'll monitor the release build tonight and ping infra if linkcheck still flakes. Thanks everyone :pray:
